Preview: - External Email - Dear Amelia Kang, Welcome to the Web of Science researcher community! Your Web of Science ResearcherID is: QUT-1332-2026. Now that you've registered you can start building up your Web of Science profile to demonstrate your scholarly impact. Import your publications and add records of your peer reviews then we'll populate your profile with citation and comparative review metrics. Import your publications You can search the Web of Science for your indexed publications . Confirm which publications are yours and we'll add them to your profile, along with your Web of Science Core Collection citation counts and h -index. Don't worry if you can't find all of your publications in the Web of Science. You can also populate your publication records by: Importing them from ORCiD Uploading a RIS, BibTex, or CSV file Searching across the web by DOI or title Add records of your peer reviews Your Web of Science researcher profile allows the full breadth of your research output to be showcased in one place. That means demonstrating your peer review history alongside your publications. There are two really simple ways to get started with peer review recognition on the Web of Science. This setting allows us to match review information for our 9,100+ partnered journals to the email addresses associated with your account and populate your review history. Forward your review receipts ("thank you for reviewing" emails from editors) to reviews@webofscience.com, and we'll curate, verify, and add a verified record of each review to your profile (unsigned and not publicly displayed) for you. Subject: Library Essential Digital Information Literacy Workshop on Thursday 6 Aug 2026

Preview: Dear students Thank you for your enthusiastic response to our Career Booster workshops so far! As we move into the middle of the semester, please refer to the remaining workshops scheduled in Sept and Oct 2026 . All workshops will be conducted either virtually via Zoom (you will receive details upon successful registration) or physically at the YIH03-05 CareerSpace ( directions ). Date/Time Workshop Description 16 Sep (Wed) 10am-12pm Inside Fintech Hiring: Roles, Skills & Market Signals Curious about what it takes to break into fintech? Join hiring leaders from Aspire, and KPay for an insider's look at the fintech talent market and what employers seek in the next generation of talent. The panel discussion will explore the diverse roles driving growth across the fintech sector, the technical and transferable skills that stand out during recruitment, and practical strategies for succeeding in internship and graduate hiring processes. Speakers will also share their perspectives on emerging industry trends, from artificial intelligence and digital payments to evolving customer expectations, and how these developments are creating new opportunities across the sector. Whether you are interested in product management, software engineering, data and analytics, operations, business development, risk, compliance, or other functions, this session will provide valuable insights to help you better understand the fintech ecosystem and position yourself for success. 17 Sep (Thu) 2-5pm Think Like a Consultant: Case Study Simulation Workshop What does it take to solve a real-world business problem under time pressure? The discussion will also explore common career pathways, including the differences between agency and in-house roles, helping students better understand the opportunities available across the profession. The excitement of graduation fades… and the uncertainty begins to creep in. “Will I get a job?” “Why am I facing so many rejections?” You’re not alone. The job search can be stressful, discouraging, and emotionally draining especially when the outcomes don’t match your expectations. Many fresh graduates find themselves in this very place. Recognise… thinking patterns that get you down when you need help and where to get it 2. Rewire… your thoughts – experiencing mindfulness for resilience to regulate difficult emotions 3. Ready, Go! Actionable plans to move forward.
